svg.title: Vigil - SOC detection lab and incident response
svg.desc: Wazuh, TheHive and OpenSearch. A four-stage web app compromise (SQL injection, XSS, IDOR, simulated ransomware), each stage detected, escalated to TheHive and closed with a written verdict.

g.text: Detection lab with Wazuh, TheHive and OpenSearch. A four-stage web
app attack, each stage detected, escalated and closed.
